Excellent commercial space for sale located in one of the most active commercial areas of Usera, just one street away from Calle Marcelo Usera, in a consolidated environment with high foot traffic.

Surface area: 52 m²
Price: €160,000
Street-level premises
Large display window with great visibility
Restroom

For more information or to arrange a visit, do not hesitate to get in touch.
